mcnetworking.cli.command.description.hel:
help Shows available commands
help <command> Shows how to use the specified command
mcnetworking.cli.command.description.int: interface <interface_name | interface_direction> Goes to the %s configuration mode for the specified interface
mcnetworking.cli.command.description.ip:
IP configuration
ip help Shows the available ip configurations
ip help <configuration> Shows how to use the specified configuration
ip address <address> Assigns an IP address to the interface
ip default_gateway <address> Sets the IP address of the default gateway
ip route <destination_network> <subnet_mask> <next_hop> adds a static route for the specified network through the specified next hop
mcnetworking.cli.command.description.pin: ping <dest_ip> [resends] Sends ICMP echo requests to the specified ip address
mcnetworking.cli.command.description.sho:
Information about the device
show help Shows the available options
show help <option> Shows which information the specified option contains
show arp_cache Shows the device's ARP cache
show interfaces Shows the device's interfaces
show ip Shows the IP address of the selected interface
show mac Shows the MAC address of the selected interface
show pos Shows the device's dimension and the position in the game world
show routing_table Shows the device's routing table
show switching_table Shows the device's switching table
mcnetworking.cli.command.description.tra: traceroute <dest_ip> Traces the route to reach the specified ip address
